She serves Crown, a fellow Nikke from her squad, as her royal aide.
Quick-witted, cunning, and fiercely loyal, she is a loyal retainer of the Crown Kingdom.

lines.text:
The number of citizens in the Crown Kingdom grows with each passing day.
Is this not truly cause for great joy?

Rapscallion!
Do not argue with Her Highness!

There's no need to worry.
Our kingdom is forever safeguarded by Her Highness, verily.

What's this? 
Have you resolved to become the advisor to our kingdom at last?
If you come into our kingdom's fold, it would be most conveni... I mean, most pleasing indeed.
Perhaps the day will come when we may impart unto you our sacred mission, Rapscallion.

Rapscallion...?!
You vanished and left all manner of menial tasks in your wake!

Such matters are but a trifle for me.
If you have business to attend to, see to it with haste.

Oh, 'tis in better shape than I had expected. 
This place is rather nice.

I'll pass on the... Splendamin.
I have brought my own sustenance.

There are many curiosities to be found here. 
I shall purchase a gift to present to Her Highness.

I am Chime, the sole and most capable royal aide of the Crown Kingdom! 
Do well to remember this!

What is this strength? 
Most wondrous it is.
Haha! Verily, I am most capable indeed!
I shall be able to lend even greater strength unto Her Highness and the Crown Kingdom.

I shall receive it with gratitude, 
but why bestow such a thing upon me so suddenly?
This shall provide great aid to the kingdom's advancement. I will use it wisely.

Such a brilliant subject you are!
I will be sure to recount your deeds to Her Highness.

What is this? 
Are you flattering me in hopes of mere crumbs?
Hmm... the more I gaze upon you, the more I see what desirable talents you possess, Rapscallion.

N-no matter what, Her Highness remains the most dear to me!
You, Rapscallion... can occupy second place.
At last, 'tis my turn to step up!
What is the matter?
Very well, I shall go forth as commanded.
Now, we proceed!
I shall lend my support, fear not!
I shall move swiftly!
I feel reassured with you here, Rapscallion.
'Tis strange, doing this after so long.
Curse it... my magazine.
M-my hand did slip, is all.
I stand ready!
Long live the Crown Kingdom! Hahaha!
I shall sweep away all in my path!
Perish, scoundrels!
Ugh! What a bother!
Begone!
Eek!
Ah!
Unghh!
I'm sorry I could not offer more aid in battle...

Behold! What did I say?
Did I not declare victory ours?
